## MVP Checklist (Landing Page + Waitlist)

- [ ] Landing page loads without errors
- [ ] Waitlist form is present and functional (or stubbed with documented next steps)
- [ ] Form submission shows a success state
- [ ] No console errors on page load
- [ ] Basic accessibility: meaningful headings, form labels, keyboard-navigable
- [ ] Lighthouse performance score ≥ 70 (or documented reason for deviation)
